newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco BMCE bank to open a German branch.
newsitem.headline: Morocco BMCE bank to open a German branch.

text.p: Morocco's leading Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur (BMCE-Bank) will open on Wednesday a new operating branch in German business centre of Frankfurt, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
"The BMCE-bank will open a representation bureau in Frankfurt on Wednesday as part of its policy to diversify its activity abroad," the spokesman said.
The decision to open a new bureau was taken after the leading German Commerzbank increased its shareholding in BMCE's capital to 10 percent worth $100 million earlier in April, he said.
The bank's chairman, Othman Benjelloun, will preside over the inauguration ceremony, which will be attended by Commerzbank officials and business community officials in Frankfurt, he added.
BMCE posted a consolidated net profits of 365.7 million dirhams in 1996, up from 301 million dirhams in 1995.
The results included business throughout Morocco and at the bank's Paris agency and in the Tangier's free zone in northern Morocco.
The bank's turnover was 2.43 billion dirhams in 1996 compared with 2.23 billion dirhams in the previous year.
